pages.title: CYBERNETIC SWISS BRUTALISM
pages.subtitle: Where 1px Craft Precision Meets Deterministic Code Automation

pages.title: 01 // THE DECORATIVE TRAP
pages.content:
Most modern web interfaces are soft. Rounded corners, pastel gradients, useless decorative animations. They want to feel friendly. They end up feeling generic.

We don't build friendly wallpaper. We build an existential blackbox. Obsidian #09090B. Dark Jet Black Canvas. Strict 1px Swiss Grid lines separating every WebGL canvas and telemetry card. JetBrains Mono typography for raw data precision.

pages.title: 02 // THE COLOR TOKENS OF AUTHORITY
pages.content:
Color is not decoration. Color is status telemetry.

Electric Indigo #5322FF: The primary signature accent for active buttons and 3D Rim Lights. Neon Cyan #00E5FF: The laser scanning beam for live telemetry data nodes. Blinking Anchor Nodes: 60FPS geometric pulse points at all four viewport corners. Every token exists to serve visual discipline. Form follows pure mechanical function.

pages.title: 03 // ZERO SILENT DRIFT SLA
pages.content:
When an AI engine generates UI components, layouts drift. Marginal padding errors accumulate. Fonts misalign. Swiss Brutalism freezes the layout parameters.

1.4s E2E Execution Speed. 99.99% Engine SLA. 60 FPS Target Frame Rate. 540ms Average RAG Latency. Meticulous graphic precision meets code automation.
